question: Would it be best for all my claude files that will be used for agents etc to live in google drive? I created a new google account to be used only for AI workflows, so it will only have files relevant to my job + ai tasks. Or would it be better to save the files locally on my macbook?
reply:
Local, in a git repo — that's actually the pattern your own CLAUDE.md already establishes (code/config in the repo, business context in the Record Layer, Drive as a *generated snapshot*). The main tradeoff: Drive syncs across devices and is easy to share with Dell, but Drive File Stream's online-only placeholders can silently hide content from grep/search — a gotcha your notes already flag from experience — while local files are what Claude Code's Read/Write/Edit tools actually operate on directly, with git giving you real version history.

The dedicated AI Google account is still useful — just for MCP-connected surfaces (Gmail-equivalent, shared docs, calendar) rather than as the home for agent config files themselves.
